faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Librarian post at IIEST Shibpur?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Librarian post at IIEST Shibpur is 07 October 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the Librarian position?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is a Master's Degree in Library Science/ Information Science/Documentation with a CGPA of 6.5 in a 10-point scale or at least 60% marks. A good academic record is also essential.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Librarian post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Librarian post is 56 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the government's recruitment rules and regulations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Librarian position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary in Pay Band 4 (Rs.37400-67000) with a Grade Pay of Rs.10000/-. The pay level is 14.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Librarian post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the post of Librarian at IIEST Shibpur through this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the Librarian post?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/EWS/OBC (NCL) candidates is Rs. 1500, and for SC/ST/PwD candidates, it is Rs. 1000.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Librarian recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a screening test, followed by a presentation, and finally an interview. Candidates must clear each stage to be considered for the post.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any experience required for the Librarian post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must have at least ten years of experience as a Deputy Librarian in a relevant institution, with at least three years in a specific pay scale, or equivalent experience.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for the Librarian position at IIEST Shibpur?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted online through the Google Form link provided in the 'Important Links' section. Ensure all required documents are uploaded in a single PDF file.

faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Official Notification PDF' link provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is recommended to read it thoroughly before applying.
